facts.fact: Libya Herald reports that Libya's state telecoms holding company LPTIC inaugurated the 8,700 km Medusa submarine cable in Misrata on 10 May 2025, a system the article says connects Libya with Mediterranean countries including Morocco, Tunisia and Egypt.

The article recalls that in November 2023 Libyan United International Company (LUIC) signed a contract to connect Libya to the Medusa submarine cable, a system it says links Libya with Morocco, Tunisia and Egypt among others.

systems.platform: submarine cable, 8,700 km, landing at Misrata
systems.owner: Libyan Post Telecommunications & Information Technology Company (LPTIC); LUIC signed the connection contract
